newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai newspaper warns investors from futures.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai newspaper warns investors from futures.

text.p: Most Chinese investors should stay out of the futures markets and concentrate on stocks, leaving futures to major companies wishing to hedge risk, the Shanghai-based Business News said on Sunday.
The newspaper said the risks in the futures markets were too high and the stock markets offered excellent profit potential in the months ahead.
"Medium and small investors should not venture into the futures markets any more, except for institutional investors and those involved in hedging," the newspaper said.
"They are much better off buying stocks. From now until after the return of Hong Kong (to China in mid-1997), China's stock markets are an excellent area for investment," it said.
